caption: The drawing shows a single glass object, specifically a wide, shallow bowl with a stem and a round base, resembling a compote or pedestal dish. The glass is depicted in a transparent, light bluish-green color, with subtle shading and highlights to indicate its smooth, glossy surface and the way light passes through it. The stem is short and rounded, supporting the bowl, which widens towards the rim and narrows at the base. The rim is thick and rounded. The entire object is rendered with soft edges and gentle contour lines. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned, drawing attention solely to the glass dish. The artist’s signature, "VAN SILVAY," is present in the lower right corner.
title: Compote
